_README: Documented justifications for Khronos glTF-Validator messages, as the
Under --strict a WARNING with no non-empty justification here FAILS the
gate. ERRORS are never waivable -- the spec allows zero and there is no
override. INFO and HINT codes never fail, but the ones we actually observe
are documented below so a future reader knows they were looked at rather
STATUS as of 2026-08-20: the Golf Mk8 mobile export produces ZERO warnings
and ZERO errors, so nothing here is currently being relied on to pass.

UNSUPPORTED_EXTENSION.justification: The validator has no schema for EXT_meshopt_compression or KHR_draco_mesh_compression, so it declines to check them. This is a statement about the validator's coverage, not a defect in the asset. Both extensions are declared in extensionsRequired and both were separately proven to load: viewer_check.py renders each build in real <model-viewer>/three.js with the matching decoder.

UNUSED_OBJECT.justification: FALSE ALARM, verified by direct inspection. Those bufferViews are referenced from primitives[].extensions.KHR_draco_mesh_compression.bufferView, and because the validator does not support that extension (see UNSUPPORTED_EXTENSION above) it cannot see the reference. A reference walk counting Draco extension bufferViews finds 0.000 MB unused in the 4.029 MB file -- every one of the 8 bufferViews is live. Do NOT 'fix' this by pruning.

BUFFER_VIEW_TARGET_MISSING.justification: bufferView.target is an optional hint that lets a loader bind a buffer without inspecting its accessors. Absent on the master; mobile_export sets it explicitly (34962 ARRAY_BUFFER / 34963 ELEMENT_ARRAY_BUFFER) when it rebuilds geometry, so the exports do not carry it.

ACCESSOR_INDEX_TRIANGLE_DEGENERATE.seen_on: master only, 17 degenerate triangles of 660,134 in the interior mesh
ACCESSOR_INDEX_TRIANGLE_DEGENERATE.justification: Zero-area triangles. Harmless to render (they rasterise to nothing) but they are a symptom of the same mesh hygiene problem as the master's zero-length normals. Removed downstream by weld/simplify; the exports report none.

ACCESSOR_VECTOR3_NON_UNIT.status: NOT WAIVED -- this is a real defect in the master and is reported, not excused.
ACCESSOR_VECTOR3_NON_UNIT.detail: 30 NORMAL vectors of length 0 in mesh 0 (carpaint). A zero normal makes lighting undefined for those vertices. The master therefore FAILS the spec's zero-error requirement as it stands. Both mobile exports report 0 errors because weld/simplify/quantize drop or renormalise the offending vertices -- but that is the export path incidentally cleaning up after the master, not the master being correct. Fixing it belongs with whoever owns the Golf geometry.
